# Photographer photos: prompts for ChatGPT or Gemini

Five photographer shops were added to the demo. Each shows three portfolio photos (15 images in all).

**How to use**
- Each prompt already ends with its style line. Copy the whole block into ChatGPT or Gemini.
- Save each image into this folder (`public/vendors/`) under the file name shown above its prompt.
- The site swaps the colour tile for the photo within a few seconds. No restart needed.
- `-1` is the shop's cover. Short on time? Do the five `-1` images first.
- Regenerate any image that comes back with text or a logo in it.
- To keep a shop's three photos consistent, generate them in one chat and add "keep the same style as the previous image".

| Shop | Style | Files |
|---|---|---|
| Hidden Lens BTS | Behind the scenes, off-guard moments | `v_hiddenlens-1..3.jpg` |
| Moodreel Atmosphere | Atmosphere and details | `v_moodreel-1..3.jpg` |
| The Portrait Room | People, portraits | `v_portraitroom-1..3.jpg` |
| Classic Moments Photo | Ceremony, formal, family groups | `v_classicmoments-1..3.jpg` |
| Flash & Friends Roaming Booth | Roaming photobooth, instant prints | `v_flashfriends-1..3.jpg` |
